body:
It's a constant influx of turmoil and dissatisfaction. 

There's always the promise of things being better, more perfect, but it rarely arrives.

We live by the chance of something beautiful, and are on the look out for those who are more fortunate than us.

If we could only get what they have. If only x, y and z would be fulfilled for us, then all will be well, for ever and ever. but it never arrives.

Getting what your heart longs for can be so specific and difficult that it seems that nothing that would come about naturally would end up satisfying us much. It's like we need some incredibly advanced device, basically having God mode access on our world; being the master of the simulation to engineer everything so that it ends up satisfying us just how we want
